subject: Spec review 1 done: derived FAIL, 10 blocking
body: Ran /sc:spec-panel-diffgate review 1 (critique, requirements+architecture) on the worker-contract spec and wrote review/spec-panel.md with 16 numbered findings (finding, severity, section, path:line) and a diffgate findings block; check --dry-run accepted it with derived verdict FAIL, 10 blocking (R1.1-R1.9, R1.16). Main defects: the WC-4 contract path does not hold for workflow and adversarial and clashes with existing status: success values, AC-1.1 contradicts the load row and puts --unattended on gated commands at P1 (auggie-review would still post), AC-2.2 and 7.2 step 6 give unreliable results, P0's core Orca text would fail AC-C1, and WC-7 does not require the Skill call. Left for the coordinator: run the real diffgate check step, which appends close-r1.md with the Reviser brief and the verdict: FAIL line to the report (I ran only the read-only calls and did not edit the spec).
